name: Berry Intelligence OS
install:
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3.12-venv
if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ] || ! .venv/bin/python -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then rm -rf .venv; python3 -m venv .venv; fi
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
.venv/bin/python -m pip install pagefind pagefind_bin

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Berry Intelligence OS FastAPI dev server (authoring mode) on http://localhost:8000
